entities.name: Church of Dusk
aliases: Vampires of the Church of Dusk
entities.description: A vampire church that teaches there is no gain without loss and no triumph without sacrifice.

entities.name: Itzama the Crested
entities.description: A speaker who counsels following her footsteps.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A speaker who longs to fly like the sunwing but is pushed back by a golden gale.

entities.name: Adrian Adanto of Lujio
entities.description: A Legion of Dawn speaker who claims land in the name of the queen and marvels at regisaur packs.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: A vampire who in the rapture of his Blood Fast destroyed the navigator's tools and steered a ship to shore by faith alone.

entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: The glorious city at the center of the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Tocatli
entities.description: The emperor's palace, the glowing heart of Pachatupa.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The realm centered on the city of Pachatupa, whose commanders favor giant death lizards and which holds sunlit places sacred.

entities.name: Chitlati
entities.description: A Lightning Rider who speaks of the rays of the sun gods.

entities.name: Kinjalli
entities.description: A sun god whose encompassing rays herald new life at dawn.

entities.name: Tilonalli
entities.description: A sun god whose searing rays carry the spark of life's eventual destruction.

entities.name: Ixalli
entities.description: A sun god whose fertile rays enliven all.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A merfolk who realized the only way to keep his enemies from the hidden city was to claim its power himself.

entities.name: Great River
entities.description: A river of Ixalan whose torrent is likened to sudden truth.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker and pirate captain who can turn a person to stone with a glance; she followed Bolas's compass into a trap.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The one who gave Vraska a thaumatic compass.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk who set a trap for Vraska.

entities.name: Thaumatic Compass
entities.description: A compass Bolas gave Vraska and Jace uses to indicate an aetheric azimuth.

entities.name: Arguel
entities.description: A vampire whose vision during his Blood Fast led him into the jungles of Ixalan.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: A bat-god of night, eternal enemy to the Threefold Sun, with a lost temple in the jungle.

entities.name: Sanctum Seekers
entities.description: The first of the knightly orders to cross the sea and still the most zealous.

entities.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
entities.description: An admiral who invites a captain to join her fleet.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A planeswalker and pirate captain who cares more about mayhem than treasure and called dinosaurs dragons.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane on which the story takes place.

entities.name: Shaper Pashona
entities.description: A shaper haunted by visions of the end of the world brought on by the search for the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact whose search brings visions of the end of the world.

entities.name: Ripley Vance
entities.description: A captain who carved cliffs with a broadside to form her fortress home.

entities.name: Spitfire Bastion
entities.description: The fortress Ripley Vance commands in place of a ship.

entities.name: Itlimoc
entities.description: A place where humans and merfolk joined their magic to invoke a blessing of fertility before the Sun Empire was born.

entities.name: Vona
entities.description: A vampire who has led armies of conquest for four hundred years.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker examining the thaumatic compass.

entities.name: Spires of Orazca
entities.description: A cryptic objective indicated by the compass.

entities.name: Stormwreck Sea
entities.description: A sea where ships blown north become trapped in unmelting ice.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: A port whose taverns fill with whispers about a new captain.

entities.name: Threefold Sun
entities.description: The sun faith of the Sun Empire, enemy of the bat-god Aclazotz.

entities.name: Blood Fast
entities.description: A vampire rite of abstention from blood that ends in sudden, explosive violence when the paladin gives in to hunger.

events.summary: Mavren Fein, in the rapture of his Blood Fast, destroys the navigator's tools and steers the ship to shore by faith alone.
events.quote: In the rapture of his Blood Fast, he destroyed the navigator's tools and steered the ship to shore by faith alone.

events.summary: Adrian Adanto claims land in the name of the queen.
events.quote: "I claim this land in the name of the queen."

events.summary: Kumena realizes the only way to protect the hidden city from his enemies is to claim its power himself.
events.quote: The truth came to Kumena like the Great River's torrent: the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city was to claim its power for himself.

events.summary: Following Bolas's thaumatic compass, Vraska blunders into the River Heralds' trap.
events.quote: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

events.summary: Arguel's vision leads him into the jungles of Ixalan to the lost temple of Aclazotz.
events.quote: Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan . . .

events.summary: Vraska's reputation spreads in High and Dry as a captain who can turn a person to stone.
events.quote: It wasn't long before the taverns of High and Dry were full of whispers about the new captain who could turn a person to stone with a glance.

events.summary: Captain Vance carves the cliffs with a broadside to form her new home, the Spitfire Bastion.
events.quote: With a broadside assault, Captain Vance carved the cliffs to form her new home.

events.summary: Before the Sun Empire, humans and merfolk join their magic to invoke a blessing of fertility on the land.
events.quote: Before the Sun Empire was born, humans and merfolk joined their magic to invoke a blessing of fertility on the land.

events.summary: Pirates venture into the interior for treasure and find something far greater.
events.quote: The pirates had ventured into the interior for treasure. They found something far greater.

events.summary: The planeswalker Angrath calls dinosaurs dragons, and the name sticks in certain pirate circles.
events.quote: When the Planeswalker Angrath called dinosaurs "dragons," the name stuck in certain pirate circles.

relations.note: Chitlati is a Lightning Rider of the Sun Empire's sun faith, speaking of Kinjalli's rays
relations.quote: "Kinjalli's encompassing rays herald new life in the moment of the sun's dawning."

relations.note: Bolas gave Vraska a thaumatic compass
relations.quote: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

relations.note: Vraska walked into the River Heralds' trap
relations.quote: Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

relations.note: The bat-god is the eternal enemy of the Threefold Sun
relations.quote: to the lost temple of a bat-god of night, eternal enemy to the Threefold Sun.

relations.note: Tocatli is the emperor's palace and the heart of Pachatupa
relations.quote: Tocatli, the emperor's palace, is its glowing heart.

relations.note: Pachatupa is the center of the Sun Empire
relations.quote: The glorious city of Pachatupa is the center of the Sun Empire
